findings.title: Return exit code 2 for an invalid repository argument (src/selfhost/observe-prs.ts:15, 58). When `GITHUBREPOSITORY` is empty or malformed, `observeRepository` throws `invalid repository` at Line 15. The catch block at Line 58 maps every thrown error to exit code 1. Doctrine I1 defines exit 1 as a thrown error and exit 2 as an argument error. The `enterWithCqEnv` path at Line 46 already uses exit 2 for bad configuration. A misconfigured repository value therefore exits differently from a misconfigured CQ value. Callers cannot tell a usage error from a runtime failure.
